projectMove.title: Get to CK Steele on time; Arena waits for Nov 5
projectMove.body: Tonight is the Tallahassee bus (booking confirmed, all legs Scheduled). Arena Phase 25 hit the weekly Codex wall and stays parked until about 2:05 PM ET on Nov 5 unless you buy credits sooner, and Testarossa will relaunch then. Today is for final bag check and boarding-pass PDF on your phone.

tip.title: Phone boarding PDF, ID, and seat 6A before you leave the house
tip.body: Ticket windows at CK Steele close before a 9:05 PM QR boarding, so have the Greyhound/Flix confirmation ready in the app or email. Keep passport card, Carnival boarding PDF for group C02, and the Dockers duffel grab-bag in one place so the Adams & Tennessee drop-off is calm.

extras.cruiseNote: The trip runs October 31 to November 5. Tallahassee Greyhound leaves tonight at 9:05 PM, Orlando transfer about 3:25 AM, Tampa about 5:00 AM, then Carnival Paradise sails from Tampa on November 1 with boarding group C02 and an 11:00 to 11:30 AM arrival window. Cozumel on November 3 is the one shore day.
extras.weatherNote: Overcast and mild, low near 67F and high near 81F with almost no chance of rain.

surprise.title: On your way out of Tampa Bay, the ship slips under the Sunshine Skyway
surprise.body: After Carnival Paradise leaves Port Tampa Bay this afternoon (scheduled around 3:30 PM), the route to the Gulf passes beneath the Sunshine Skyway Bridge, the cable-stayed span with 42 yellow steel cables that opened in 1987. Its ship channel clearance is about 180 feet, which is exactly why Tampa only gets ships built to fit under it: newer giants like the Oasis class stand around 236 feet tall and could never make it in. Sunset in Tampa is at 5:45 PM, with twilight until about 6:10, though the forecast shows clouds and showers building from mid-afternoon, so the view may come with a little drama. One more gift: clocks fell back an hour at 2 AM, so today is a 25-hour day. Bon voyage, Zae.
